evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Identity-level thesis stated as bedrock — categorical distinction without hedge, the kind of constitutive values language the speaker treats as foundational.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Creed-level restatement of the same thesis — permanence language ('the asset you keep') frames a constitutive value, not a moveable claim.
